title: Viakifishi (Theme 8: Uhalifu wa mtandaoni)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child uses alama za mtajo for speech, titles and quoted words, and the mshazari for choices (na/au) and dates (12/11/2026).
steps: Is it speech, a title or a quoted word?
A choice or a date? Use the mshazari.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "5/3/2026" and one title in marks.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni alama ipi hunukuu maneno halisi ya mtu?" Kwa nini "mshazari" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Alama za mtajo hunukuu maneno halisi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni alama ipi hutenga machaguo kama ama/au?" Kwa nini "koma" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni tarehe ipi imeandikwa kwa mshazari?" Kwa nini "12.11.2026" si jibu sahihi?

listen_for: Nilisoma kitabu cha Kilio cha Msitu.
misconceptions.repair: Weka jina la kitabu katika alama za mtajo.

checks.question: Andika vizuri: wanafunzi na au walimu
Andika vizuri jina la kitabu: Kisima cha Matumaini
